one_liner: FX forensic audit protocol (FINTRAC-registered) that audits cross-border B2B payment fees and FX spreads via API and MCP server.

auth.evidence_quote: HTTP Bearer token in Authorization header.
auth.notes: Keys are prefixed ipx_live_ / ipx_test_ and referred to as API keys, sent as Bearer tokens.

access.evidence_quote: How to get a key: Open your iPayX dashboard → API keys
access.notes: Free tier tools available (audit_fx_transaction, check_fx_mid_market_rate); paid tier for full_forensic_fx_report.

api.notes: Vendor publishes an official MCP server directly documented at ipayx.ai/docs/mcp-server with a small number of tools (3 primary tools found); a separate REST API reference is referenced but not directly verified in this pass.

verdict.rationale: Free API key, official vendor-published MCP server, and documented Bearer-token REST auth make this immediately buildable.
